'''Thulian Merast''' was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who commanded the [[Eradicator (starship)|''Eradicator'']] during the beginning years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Assigned by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] to patrol the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]], Merast and his crew [[Death/Legends|died]] when the ''Eradicator'' was critically damaged as a result of a light storm during the search for the ''[[FarStar]]''.
